heritage.heading: Centuries of Celuk metallurgy.
heritage.subtext: For over a century, the smithing families of Celuk Village have guarded the techniques of Balinese precious metalwork: jawan (micro-granulation), bun (hand-drawn wire filigree), and cold-hammered structural forging.
heritage.statement: We reject hollow factory stamping. Every Artfuli piece carries the dense weight of hand-forged metal and the direct signature of the smith who shaped it.
heritage.note: By operating our own private foundry and finishing benches in Sukawati, we eliminate luxury distributor markups while guaranteeing fair artisan remuneration and complete metallurgical traceability.
heritage.caption: Jalan Raya Celuk No. 88, Sukawati, Gianyar. Hand-soldering sterling silver granules over a coconut-shell charcoal brazier.

silver.title: 92.5% Pure Silver + 7.5% Oxygen-Free Copper
silver.desc: We alloy pure 999 silver bullion exclusively with electrolytic oxygen-free copper in our Sukawati crucibles. This prevents fire-scale porosity and delivers higher tensile hardness than commercial scrap silver.
silver.method: Verification Protocol: Olympus Vanta XRF Spectrometer · Batch Tolerance +/- 0.05%
silver.norm: 89% to 92% mixed reclaimed scrap alloyed with brass and de-oxidizing silicon additives.
silver.status: Status: XRF Batch Verified in Celuk

vermeil.title: 2.5 to 3.0 Microns Solid 18k Gold over 925 Silver
vermeil.desc: Our vermeil pieces undergo multi-stage electro-bonding of 18k solid yellow gold over a solid 925 sterling silver core, exceeding FTC vermeil thickness requirements for heirloom longevity.
vermeil.method: Verification Protocol: X-Ray Fluorescence Coating Thickness Gauge · Minimum 2.5 µm
vermeil.norm: 0.1 to 0.5 micron flash gold electroplate over brass or mystery base metal.

hypoallergenic.title: 100% Free of Nickel, Lead, and Cadmium
hypoallergenic.desc: Every earring post, clasp, and ring shank is formulated without nickel, lead, or cadmium brighteners, making every Artfuli creation safe for sensitive skin and continuous daily wear.
hypoallergenic.method: Verification Protocol: EN 1811 Bio-Release Assay & Full Elemental XRF Scan
hypoallergenic.norm: Nickel undercoat frequently applied beneath thin gold plating as a cheap leveler.

solder.title: High-Fineness Silver and 18k Gold Hard Solder
solder.desc: Traditional Balinese granulation requires high-temperature eutectic fusing. We formulate our own hard solders matching the karat and fineness of the parent metal so joints never discolor.
solder.method: Verification Protocol: Sukawati Foundry Assay Log · Metallurgical Joint Inspection
solder.norm: Low-melting zinc and tin repair solder that oxidizes dark grey over time.

guarantee.headline: Provenance and 100-Year Care
guarantee.subtext: Every piece that leaves our Sukawati workshop is built to outlive its first owner. We back our metallurgy with transparent sourcing and lifetime structural care.
guarantee.warrantyDesc: Should any Artfuli clasp, shank, or bezel setting experience a structural fault under normal wear, our Celuk workshop repairs or re-forges the piece free of charge.
guarantee.recycledDesc: We refine and alloy certified recycled Indonesian silver and gold granules in-house, reducing primary mining impact while maintaining 99.9% base bullion purity prior to alloying.
guarantee.renewalDesc: Every collector receives lifetime access to ultrasonic cleaning, river-agate repolishing, and at-cost 2.5-micron 18k gold re-vermeil servicing at our Bali atelier.
